body:
There are other methods in `Tree` which error when `blocked > 0` (a state which only occurs during mouse event propagation). Those methods are `set_columns` and `clear`.

The docs remark you added should probably be added to those methods as well? Otherwise it's weirdly inconsistent.

Also I strongly urge you to modify the three error macros that check for `blocked > 0` to include an *error message*, to make it easier to understand why it fails, for example:

```diff
- ERR_FAIL_COND(blocked > 0);
+ ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(blocked > 0, "Tree is locked during mouse selection events. Use \"call_deferred()\" to modify the tree.");
```
